verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              यन्मां पृच्छसि राजेन्द्र सिन्धुराजस्य विक्रमम्।  शृणु तत् सर्वमाख्यास्ये यथा पाण्डूनयोधयत्॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said You ask me, O mighty monarch, to describe the prowess of the ruler of Sindhus. I shall describe all that in detail. Hear how he fought with the sons of Pandu.

verses.sanskrit: तमूहुर्वाजिनो वश्या सैन्धवाः साधुवाहिनः।  विकुर्वाणा बृहन्तोऽश्वाः श्वसनोपमरंहसः॥२॥
verses.english: Excellent steeds of the Sindhu breed obedient to the behests of the charioteer and fleet as the wind itself, carried him to the field of battle.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वनगराकारं विधिवत्कल्पितं रथम्।  तस्याभ्यशोभयत्केतुर्वाराहो राजतो महान्॥३॥

verses.english: With white umbrellas, with pernons and with the yak-tails that were used to fan him, with all these emblems of royalty, he appeared beautiful like the moon in the midst of myriad of stars.

verses.sanskrit: मुक्तावज्रमणिस्वर्णैर्भूषितं तमयस्मयम्।  वरूथं विबभौ तस्य ज्योतिर्भिः स्वमिवावृतम्॥५॥
verses.english: His iron-made car-fence embossed with pearls, diamonds and gold, appeared effulgent like the welkin bespangled with the luminaries.

verses.sanskrit: स विस्फार्य महच्चापं किरन्निषुगणान् बहून्।  तत् खण्डं पूरयामास यद्व्यदारयदार्जुनिः॥६॥
verses.english: Stretching his mighty bow and shooting numerous shafts, he filled up the Kaurava array there where Arjuna's son had created breaches.

verses.sanskrit: स सात्यकिं त्रिभिर्बाणैरष्टभिश्च वृकोदरम्।  धृष्टद्युम्नं तथा षष्ट्या विराटं दशभिः शरैः॥७॥
verses.english: He wounded Satyaki with three arrows, Vrikodara with eight, Dhrishtadyumna with sixty and Virata with ten and Drupada with five sharp arrows and Sikhandin with ten. He pierced the Kekayas with twenty-five, the Draupadeyas with three shafts each. Then piercing Yudhishthira with seventy arrows, he inangled the rest of luis army with a mighty downpour of arrows; and that feat appeared indeed wonderful.

verses.sanskrit: द्रुपदं पञ्चभिस्तीक्ष्णैः सप्तभिश्च शिखण्डिनम्।  केकयान् पञ्चविंशत्या द्रौपदेयांस्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः॥८॥
युधिष्ठिरं तु सप्तत्या ततः शेषानपानुदत्।  इषुजालेन महता तद‌द्भुतमिवाभवत्॥९॥
अथास्य शितपीतेन भल्लेनादिश्य कार्मुकम्।  चिच्छेद प्रहसन् राजा धर्मपुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥१०॥
verses.english: Thereupon, O king, the highly puissant son of Dharma (Yudhishthira), laughing the while, cut-off, with a sharp and well-tempered arrow the bow the ruler of the Sindhus.

verses.sanskrit: अक्ष्णोर्निमेषमात्रेण सोऽन्यदादाय कार्मुकम्।  विव्याध दशभिः पार्थं तांश्चैवान्यांस्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः॥११॥
तत् तस्य लाघवं ज्ञात्वा भीमो भल्लौस्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः।  धनुर्ध्वजं च च्छत्रं च क्षितौ क्षिप्रमपातयत्॥१२॥
verses.english: Beholding that light-handedness displayed by Jayadratha, Bhima, with three broad-headed shafts, once more cut-off and felled to the ground the bow, the standard and the umbrella of the former.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽन्यदादाय बलवान् सज्जं कृत्वा च कार्मुकम्।  भीमस्यापातयत् केतुं धनुरश्वांश्च मारिष॥१३॥
verses.english: Taking up and stringing another bow, that puissant hero (Jayadratha) cut down, O sire, the standard, the bow and the steeds of Bhima.

verses.sanskrit: स हताश्वादवप्लुत्य च्छिन्नधन्वा रथोत्तमात्।  सात्यकेराप्लुतो यानं गिर्यग्रमिव केसरी॥१४॥
verses.english: Thereupon Bhima with his bow burst open, jumped down from his excellent chariot of which the steeds were slain and leapt upor the car of Satyaki like a lion leaping upon the top of a hill.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्वदीयाः संहृष्टाः साधु साध्विति वादिनः।  सिन्धुराजस्य तत् कर्म प्रेक्ष्याश्रद्धेयमद्भुतम्॥१५॥
verses.english: At this, your troops filled with delight, cried out saying “Well dene, Well done' and they applauded that feat achieved by the Sindhu king again and again.

verses.sanskrit: संक्रुद्धान् पाण्डवानेको यद्द‌धारास्त्रतेजसा।  तत्तस्य कर्म भूतानि सर्वाण्येवाभ्यपूजयन्॥१६॥
सौभद्रेण हतैः पूर्वं सोत्तरायोधिभिर्द्विपैः।  पाण्डूनां दर्शितः पन्थाः सैन्धवेन निवारितः॥१७॥
यतमानास्तु ते वीरा मात्स्यपञ्चालकेकयाः।  पाण्डवाश्चान्वपद्यन्त प्रतिशेकुर्न सन्धवम्॥१८॥
verses.english: Then the Matsyas, the Panchalas, the Kekayas and the Pandavas, all these heroic warriors exerting their best, tried to follow Abhimanyu, but they could not withstand the ruler of the Sindhus.

verses.sanskrit: यो यो हि यतते भेत्तुं द्रोणानीकं तवाहितः।  तं तमेव वरं प्राप्य सैन्धवः प्रत्यवारयत्॥१९॥
verses.english: Every one of your enemy who tried to penetrate through Drona's array was checked by the ruler of the Sindhus in consequence of the boon the latter had obtained from Mahadeva.
